formal_treatment: They are requester-supplied provenance metadata only.

claim: Four homogeneous coordinates provide seven mutually perpendicular axes.
formal_treatment: At most four mutually orthogonal nonzero directions exist in Euclidean R^4.

claim: A declared R^7 profile can contain seven orthogonal axis lines.
formal_treatment: The seven standard basis axes are pairwise orthogonal; this is independent of SDF or LSB notation.
It defines the zero level set of the chosen field; a sphere requires f(x)=||x-c||-r.

claim: Every implicit field is an exact signed-distance function.
formal_treatment: Exact-distance status is an explicit capability and can fail after generic morphs/blends.

claim: SDF=0 automatically smooths a fractal or removes jaggedness.
formal_treatment: Rounding requires an explicit offset/filter/blend and may still have singularities.

claim: LSB or zero-based indexing reduces the Hamming distance between 943 and 937.
formal_treatment: Indexing changes labels/access rules, not the numeric bit difference.

claim: A parity bit may select one of two declared maps/routes.
formal_treatment: This is the narrow parity-hinge semantics used by the implementation.

claim: A parity bit by itself performs arbitrary multi-bit mutation.
formal_treatment: Route selection and numeric mutation are distinct operations.

claim: Chronology is obtained merely by treating w as time.
formal_treatment: The substrate declares a time domain, flow/predictor, event solver and transition record.

claim: The chronotemporal latch makes topology state piecewise constant between events.
formal_treatment: This is the formal interpretation adopted here.

claim: Compact notation gives zero-byte VRAM and constant-time infinite rendering.
formal_treatment: Code and state still occupy memory and reconstruction has measurable ALU, cache and control cost.

claim: KLSC1/KLOC1 can avoid materializing a dense timeline for selected queries.
formal_treatment: Useful only when the model is reconstructible and reconstruction cost/error meet the application budget.

claim: Topology is explicit gluing/routing rather than physical self-intersection or energy creation.
formal_treatment: This is the core semantics used in UGTS and KLB.

claim: The Tom Klootwijk Manifold is globally smooth in every profile.
formal_treatment: It is generally a hybrid stratified quotient; only regular strata are smooth manifolds under regularity assumptions.

claim: FNV chain hashes prove authorship or identity.
formal_treatment: They are deterministic integrity checks, not signatures.
